protocol_metadata.hypothesis_tested: H7 — The canonical class-loss weighting scheme changes optimization behavior and development performance on OPS-02.

scientific_question: Does changing only the class-loss-weight vector change development performance under the frozen OPS-02 protocol?

single_independent_variable.description: The 12-element 1D float32 tensor passed to nn.CrossEntropyLoss(weight=...). Tests the complete class-loss-weighting scheme as a single object.

control_condition.name: Canonical C16 Sqrt-Median-Frequency Class Weights
control_condition.derivation_source: OPS-02 TRAIN partition valid pixels (8,401,060 valid pixels across 132 tiles)
control_condition.precision_audit_verdict: C16 executed the exact 6-decimal literal vector converted to torch.float32. Historical executed vector matches future control vector exactly.

treatment_condition.name: Uniform Unweighted Class Weights
treatment_condition.rationale: Produces exact unweighted cross-entropy loss without introducing background weight penalties (e.g. BG=0.2) or multi-variable confounding.

locked_experimental_dimensions.description: 19 independently machine-locked experimental/protocol dimensions holding all non-weight factors identical between control and treatment.

invariants.value: GeoTIFF float32 single-band VV SAR, 256x256, 10x10 block raw DN
12 dense classes (0: BG ... 11: HM; Dense 3=LWA, Dense 9=Eddy)
SOURCE LABELS 3 (Iceberg), 9 (Sea Ice), 14 (Mineral Oil Spill) mapped to ignore_index=-100
0.01 (applied to 2D conv/linear weights only; bias and 1D BN excluded)
Physical batch = 8, accumulation steps = 2, effective batch = 16
Candidate F Hybrid (70% parent-balanced, 30% class-balanced, 72 draws per epoch)
Base seed 42, epoch seed formula: 42 + epoch * 1000
Disabled (deterministic loaders, zero stochastic spatial/radiometric transforms)
dev_mIoU_phenomena (classes 1..11, BG excluded), early stopping patience=10, min_epoch=15

loss_implementation_semantics.reduction_formula: Loss = sum_{i: y_i != -100} w_{y_i} * ell_i / sum_{i: y_i != -100} w_{y_i}

model_initialization_contract.conv1_adaptation: Mean of 3 RGB pretrained channels across dim=1

rng_parity_contract.persistence: initial_rng_state.pt persisted to disk before training
rng_parity_contract.restoration: Restored identically and independently before epoch 0 for both conditions
rng_parity_contract.boundary_disclaimer: Universal bitwise reproducibility is not claimed beyond what the verified execution environment supports.

sample_schedule_reuse_contract.generation: Generated once under canonical RNG rules, saved to disk, and hashed
sample_schedule_reuse_contract.execution: Fed identically to control and treatment DataLoaders to eliminate independent sampler divergence

input_target_integrity_contract.method: Per-sample deterministic checksums (SHA256 of transformed input tensor, target tensor, and validity mask)
input_target_integrity_contract.assertion: control_checksum[s] == treatment_checksum[s] for all 132 training samples
input_target_integrity_contract.storage_efficiency: Integrity contract uses cryptographic checksums; does not duplicate large raster files

batchnorm_parity_contract.nondeterminism_caveat: The only intentional experimental difference is the class-loss-weight vector; any incidental numerical nondeterminism must be monitored and documented.

step_1_divergence_contract.post_step_1_expectation: Divergence is expected due to differing loss vectors
step_1_divergence_contract.logging: Record pre-step hash, post-step-1 control hash, post-step-1 treatment hash
step_1_divergence_contract.epistemic_rule: Divergence itself is an execution parity sanity check, NOT evidence for H7.

invalid_conditions: NaN or Inf encountered in loss, logits, or gradient tensors
Initial model state SHA256 mismatch between control and treatment
Batch schedule or sample sequence mismatch
Optimizer or scheduler state mismatch before step 1
BatchNorm configuration or initial running stats mismatch
Firewall breach: any access to HOLDOUT partition (count > 0) or Part-III directory
Unhandled runtime exceptions, OOM, or premature process crash
invalidation_criteria.model_collapse_policy: Degenerate or poor model outputs (including complete background-collapse or zero foreground predictions) are RECORDED and investigated as observed model behavior under the test protocol. They do NOT automatically invalidate the run unless accompanied by an implementation, numerical, or protocol integrity failure.
invalidation_criteria.gradient_norm_policy: Large but finite gradient norms are RECORDED and tracked, not automatically invalidated. Zero gradients are RECORDED and investigated.

evaluation_and_metrics.primary_metric: dev_mIoU_phenomena (macro unweighted mean of IoU across classes 1 through 11, background excluded)
evaluation_and_metrics.reporting_rule: Always report exact control_mIoU, treatment_mIoU, and delta_mIoU. No arbitrary threshold.
secondary_metrics: Subgroup metrics (Dominant: MCC/POW/IWs, Intermediate: BS/WS/Eddy, Ultra-Sparse: AF/OF/RF/LWA/HM)
Observational training diagnostics (gradient norms, loss curves, lr trajectory)

positive_observed_difference.meaning: Supports a contribution from the class-loss-weighting scheme to development performance under the frozen protocol.
positive_observed_difference.bounds: Does NOT prove gradient competition, optimization instability, sole causality, or global optimality of uniform weighting.

negative_observed_difference.meaning: Provides empirical evidence that uniform weighting did not improve development performance under the frozen protocol.
negative_observed_difference.bounds: Does NOT prove that canonical weighting is globally optimal.

near_zero_observed_difference.meaning: Weakens the hypothesis that class-loss weighting is a major contributor to the observed limitation under this protocol.
near_zero_observed_difference.bounds: Only used where justified by explicitly reported post hoc descriptive context. Does not eliminate all possible weighting effects.
